mentions.name: Symbiote
mentions.description: A beta, ad- and subscription-free Android workout app that offers "smart progression" features similar to Alpha Progression or MacroFactor Workout and lets users run any training program, similar to Boostcamp.
mentions.problem: Comparable workout apps with smart progression or program support rely on ads and subscriptions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
If you are looking for a workout app with Alpha Progression or MacroFactor Workout-like “Smart Progression,” or an app where you can run any program like Boostcamp but ad- and subscription-free, check out the Symbiote workout app (beta)
https://symbiote-studio.macrocodex.app/
mentions.author: faangguyindia
